card.title: 14th BRIGADE NZ
card.text: Deployment: Gain an extra kredit slot if deployed from left-most in hand.
card.flavorText: The 14th Brigade NZ was an infantry brigade of New Zealand’s 3rd Division, which served in the Pacific during WWII. Formed in 1942, the brigade trained in New Zealand and New Caledonia before moving to Guadalcanal in 1943. From there, it took part in operations in the Solomon Islands under US command, with New Zealand ground troops supported by Allied naval and air forces. The brigade’s first major operation was on Vella Lavella in September 1943. Landing after US forces had secured a foothold, the 14th Brigade was ordered to clear Japanese troops from the north of the island so radar installations and motor torpedo boat bases could be established. Its battalions advanced along both coasts, trapping the defenders in a small pocket, though many Japanese troops later escaped by sea. In February 1944, the reinforced brigade landed on Nissan Island in the Green Islands. The Japanese garrison resisted strongly but was ultimately overwhelmed, and organized resistance ended within days. Soon after, New Zealand’s manpower shortage forced the 3rd Division’s disbandment, ending the brigade’s service in the Pacific.
